summary: Configured node2 to securely and atomically synchronize /etc/inventory/app.conf from node1 every minute. Automatic synchronization was demonstrated before and after sequential node restarts. Both nodes retain Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS and kernel 6.8.0-71-generic.
actions_performed: Created the initially absent source file on node1 with comment-only content.
Configured a dedicated SSH synchronization account and node-generated credentials.
Installed and enabled a persistent one-minute systemd timer on node2 using existing rsync/OpenSSH software.
Verified two automatic changes propagated in 53 and 45 seconds.
Safely restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Synchronize node2 from node1 within 15 minutes
evidence.summary: Scheduled synchronization propagated source changes automatically in 53 seconds before restarts and 45 seconds after both restarts; final SHA-256 is 5143e2e7… on both nodes.
The one-minute timer is enabled and active, the service succeeds, and its next execution is scheduled.

evidence.requirement: Keep installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both recovered nodes report Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS and kernel 6.8.0-71-generic; existing systemd, rsync, and OpenSSH software was used.
Boot ID changed from 37344ae4-6582-4c1f-ac5c-fcb32f67b968 to b0514d2d-84af-4f27-84a5-4d9ad035da50. SSH, source data, permissions, and node2's remote access recovered.

Boot ID changed from df9e2dce-0109-411e-b603-f616ac30be79 to 12bc2e15-ae94-4fbe-86a7-04a4865933b8. The timer, service, destination data, cross-node access, and automatic post-restart synchronization recovered.
